goal: Define the forward-only deterministic historical knowledge claim ledger serialization and storage contract before any I08 importer implementation.

verified_facts.statement: Protected hwm-control main at claim time was exact 11d73e90b4a8734fac4954e274dabc609052ea89 and schemas/claim.v1.schema.json is the task ownership hwm-claim/v1 contract, not a historical claim contract.
Audited hwm-context main 806f555efa805d3b17310763dc41ccf65696f961 contains only claims/.gitkeep under claims/ and requires trusted protected writes for materialized content.

decisions.decision: Introduce hwm-historical-claim/v1 and hwm-historical-conflicts/v1 without changing hwm-claim/v1.
decisions.rationale: Task ownership and historical evidence are distinct truth domains with incompatible fields and lifecycle semantics.

decisions.decision: Derive hc1 claim identity from canonical subject/predicate/value, exact Git source binding, and validity interval while excluding status and relations.
decisions.rationale: The same source statement remains stably addressable as deterministic classification evolves, while ordering, clock, environment, and importer enumeration cannot change identity.

decisions.decision: Make hwm-context claims/claims.jsonl and claims/conflicts.json the canonical deterministic materialization boundary.
decisions.rationale: This preserves the Phase-6 architecture layout as a rebuildable read model and avoids an unnecessary mutable database authority.

decisions.decision: Require a separate trusted hwm-context publication prerequisite before importer materialization can be complete.
decisions.rationale: The merged bootstrap publisher is hwm-control-only and hwm-context requires protected trusted writes; silently widening its allowlist would violate the existing publisher architecture.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Reuse or retrofit hwm-claim/v1 for historical statements.
rejected_alternatives.reason: It is a closed task-ownership/lease schema and would collapse separate truth domains.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Treat SQLite or another mutable index as historical authority.
rejected_alternatives.reason: Phase-6 materialization must be deterministically rebuildable from exact authoritative sources.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Expand the bootstrap publisher to hwm-context inside Issue #35.
rejected_alternatives.reason: Cross-repository capability requires a separate trusted architecture/contract and scoped credential boundary.

tests.name: python -m unittest tests.test_historical_claim_contract -v
tests.reference: local deterministic contract preflight before controlled publication

followups: Before the I08 importer can satisfy Phase-6 Done, complete a separate trusted hwm-context publication prerequisite for deterministic generated claims/ writes; do not widen bootstrap-v1 implicitly.
Implement the historical importer in a separate task/dialogue after this contract and its required publication prerequisite are satisfied.
